verdicts.reason: A rebuilds the layout for the new shape: the headline sits vertically centred on the left and the product circle is large on the right. But the oversized Try It pill almost touches the bottom of the circle, 'Out now.' is cut off from the headline and dangles beside the button, and the lower-left quadrant is dead space. B keeps the original reading order, but the whole row sits in the top 60% of the canvas with a large empty band below. The headline is not aligned with the small product circle, which drifts above it, and the CTA is jammed against the right edge with little margin, so B looks lopsided and unfinished.
